status_history.reason: Extracted from CASE-005 production evidence. Awaiting current HyperFrames rendering, three-mode compositing, and cross-aspect-ratio frame inspection before promotion.

title: Restrained Gradient Flow
summary: A dark brand-manifesto visual world with high energy restrained by strict quotas. Near-black canvas, cool white text, restricted four-color gradient flows, metallic gray giant titles, and three-voice typography. One sentence per frame, one hero per shot.
best_for: real data reveals with source attribution

canvas.tone: near-black restrained intensity with cool white signal
canvas.background_policy: Use near-black (not pure #000) as the dominant field so the restricted gradient accents and metallic type read as intentional contrast rather than default dark mode.

palette.strategy: One near-black field plus one cool white text role plus a restricted four-color gradient accent set with a per-shot budget. No brand hex values are copied.

roles.value_policy: near-black with subtle depth, never pure #000
cool white, the strongest contrast against the field

roles.semantic: restricted four-color flow for emphasis and motion
roles.value_policy: at most one gradient accent active per shot; the four colors form a family and are never used all at once outside the ribbon motif
metallic gray with subtle gradient, heavier than cool white but subordinate to the gradient accent when both are present

roles.purpose: carry the single headline or giant number per frame
roles.style_relation: largest weight, metallic or cool white, Kanit or equivalent wide geometric display

roles.purpose: source attribution, metadata, and secondary labels
roles.style_relation: smaller, quieter, Noto Sans SC or equivalent readable sans

roles.purpose: data, progress values, and technical annotations
roles.style_relation: smallest, monospaced, for HUD-like precision without dominating

typography.local_fallback_policy: Select installed fonts by role and verify actual rendered glyph coverage. Do not assume Kanit, Noto Sans SC, or any specific Mono font is available.

visual_system.whitespace_policy: Reserve negative space around the single hero element. Offset composition is preferred over dead-center symmetry. The gradient accent and ribbon occupy the periphery.

focus_policy.rule: One sentence or one giant number owns the frame. All other elements are subordinate annotation, HUD, or structural dividers.

purposes: declare a key phrase or judgment
open or close a section with impact
scene_grammar.composition: One cool white or metallic gray headline centered or offset, with quiet source annotation and optional thin divider. No competing text.
required_semantics: a single declarative sentence or phrase

purposes: anchor a data claim with visual weight
scene_grammar.composition: One giant number in metallic gray or cool white, with a compact source HUD line below. The number is the hero; the source is quiet verification.
required_semantics: a verifiable source or context label
forbidden_uses: multiple competing metrics in one frame
using big-number styling for non-numeric keywords

purposes: show a quantified stage or ratio
scene_grammar.composition: A thin horizontal divider line with a compact mono progress label. Occupies a narrow band; the rest of the frame belongs to the current hero.
required_semantics: a real stage, ratio, or structural marker
forbidden_uses: empty decorative dividers without semantic meaning
progress bars that imply false precision

purposes: add a restrained brand energy signature
frame a section without competing with the hero
scene_grammar.composition: A thin ribbon stroke or partial outline in the gradient accent colors, placed at the periphery. Never occupies the hero region.
required_semantics: a section boundary or energy accent that does not carry content meaning
forbidden_uses: full four-color gradient flow on every frame
using the ribbon to carry text or data

entries.semantic_trigger: A real numeric value is revealed.
entries.action: Animate the number from zero or a base value to its target, with a brief settle at the end.
entries.result_state: The final number is static and readable as the confirmed value.
entries.hold_policy: Reserve a content-dependent result hold after the count-up completes without extending the SRT window.

entries.semantic_trigger: The narration reaches a high-energy claim or transition.
entries.action: Move a restricted subset of the four-color gradient flow across a text or structural element, completing within the shot window.
entries.result_state: The element returns to its base cool white or metallic gray; the gradient flow recedes.
entries.hold_policy: The gradient flow is a transient event. Hold the base state after it completes.

entries.semantic_trigger: A section boundary or structural marker is introduced.
entries.action: Draw a thin ribbon stroke along a peripheral path using the gradient accent colors, completing within the shot.
entries.result_state: The completed ribbon remains as a quiet structural frame for the section.
entries.hold_policy: The ribbon persists as ambient structure for the section duration, then exits cleanly.

entries.semantic_trigger: A key phrase or title demands maximum impact.
entries.action: Scale and land the metallic gray headline from a slight push with a fast deceleration, giving a physical weight sensation.
entries.result_state: The headline is fully readable at its target size with no residual motion.
entries.hold_policy: Reserve a reading hold after the punch-in lands. Do not chain two punch-in events without an intervening quiet shot.

global_rules: Derive all motion from deterministic local time.
At most one high-energy entry (energy 4-5) per shot; do not stack count-up, gradient-flow-sweep, and punch-in in the same frame.
Simplify the choreography when the fixed SRT window cannot contain the full action.
Energy must vary across adjacent shots; never back-to-back punch-in or back-to-back gradient-flow-sweep.

modes.usage: Primary presentation with the near-black field filling the frame.
constraints: Do not add burned-in subtitles or BGM.
The near-black field must extend to all edges.

modes.usage: Isolate individual text elements, dividers, and ribbon strokes for overlay composition.
constraints: Move any soft glow or blur to a separate black-background light layer.

modes.usage: This draft has no validated glow-only or particle-only expression.
constraints: Do not relabel an opaque full-frame render as a light layer.
verification_requirements: A future version must add blend-mode and black-level evidence before enabling this mode.

hard_rules: Choose the scene from the sentence meaning before selecting a visual component.
Keep the SRT timeline fixed; never stretch a shot to fit motion.
One hero per frame; the gradient accent and ribbon are never the hero.
Use real data and verifiable sources; never invent numbers to fill a big-number scene.
do: Make the hero readable without subtitles.
Use offset composition over dead-center symmetry.
Vary energy level and scene grammar across adjacent shots.
Keep the gradient accent restrained — one gradient event per shot maximum.
dont: Copy the original brand ∞ logo or any brand identifier.
Use all four gradient colors simultaneously outside the ribbon motif.
Chain punch-in events back-to-back without a quiet intervening shot.
Use the metallic gray title treatment for body text or source annotations.
Place decorative gradients behind paragraphs of text.

adaptation_knobs.adaptation_goal: Control how many gradient-flow events appear per section without exhausting the effect.
constraints: Never exceed one gradient-flow event per shot.
A section with zero gradient-flow events is valid when the content is quiet.

adaptation_knobs.adaptation_goal: Adjust how much metallic gray treatment is used without turning every text element into a title.
constraints: Never apply metallic treatment to body text or source annotations.

adaptation_knobs.adaptation_goal: Shift between offset and centered hero placement to vary rhythm across a section.
constraints: Do not use the same bias for more than two consecutive shots.

adaptation_knobs.adaptation_goal: Scale the overall motion energy ceiling per section while preserving the per-shot single-high-energy rule.
constraints: A section-level ceiling of 5 is reserved for openings and closings.
Never assign energy 5 to two adjacent shots.

signature_motifs.description: Restricted four-color gradient flow across a thin peripheral ribbon or structural stroke, paired with near-black field and metallic gray type.
Metallic gray giant headline punch-in as the single hero of a frame, with quiet source annotation below.

exhausted_motifs.reason: It replaces the actual gradient-flow energy and data claim with an overused generic symbol.
Code rain or terminal刷屏 replaces real content with decorative tech filler.
Four-card 2x2 stagger competes with the single-hero rule and flattens the gradient-flow energy into templated repetition.
Background gradient drift plus bottom progress bar scaleX is a semantically empty rhythm filler incompatible with the restrained-gradient-flow constraint that every frame carries a real claim.

conflicts_with.reason: Both are dark-background technology visual worlds, but restrained-gradient-flow is a fullscreen brand manifesto with restricted four-color gradient flow and metallic type, while neon-cyber-overlay is a transparent functional HUD with cyan/pink/purple tricolor coding. Applying manifesto gradients to transparent code cards destroys both identities.
conflicts_with.resolution: Borrow at most the offset composition or single-sentence-hero scene grammar; do not borrow the tricolor, transparent cards, or code blocks.

borrowable_patterns.description: A portable one-sentence-one-hero frame structure without the near-black field or gradient-ribbon signature.
conditions: The borrowing template provides its own field and accent system.
The narration contains a real declarative sentence.

borrowable_patterns.description: A portable giant-number-with-source-HUD layout without the metallic gray treatment or gradient accent.
conditions: A real numeric value with a verifiable source exists.
The borrowing template restyles the number and source label with its own palette.

restrictions: Do not distribute source media, private copy, or local paths.
Do not include the original brand ∞ logo or business copy.

forbidden_materials: private source media and business copy
brand logos, proprietary fonts, product interfaces, and the original ∞ mark

stale_rules.original_claim: Scene animations must use only fromTo, never bare from or gsap.to(), to guarantee deterministic seek behavior.
stale_rules.isolation_reason: The intent of seek-safe animation is preserved, but the specific API constraint must be verified against current HyperFrames core, keyframes, and animation skills.

stale_rules.original_claim: Ambient motion must be attached to a timeline and must never use bare looping.
stale_rules.isolation_reason: The deterministic and seekable intent is preserved, but the exact adapter contract for loops, local time, and seek must be verified against the current HyperFrames version.

stale_rules.original_claim: Fixed 4K resolution, pixel-level type scale, and 30fps are universal production defaults.
stale_rules.isolation_reason: Pixel values, type scales, and frame rates from the original project are only valid for that specific canvas and output mode. Cross-aspect-ratio and cross-output-mode adaptation must derive values from the current target canvas.
